provenance.archive_handling: Read regular members only with reviewed archive_files; no new extraction or archive execution. Existing extraction was filter=data. All Python entry points run with -I.

public_redaction.policy: Partner paths, hostnames and job identifiers replaced with neutral placeholders; scientific numbers and hashes retained.

rescoring.policy: Tier A contains decision-bearing C bounds; Tier B is OPTIONAL/diagnostic, including all return-1 probe packages R022–R036. Probe nominations will be decided by message 2’s repaired four-arm re-probe, not rescoring confounded return-1 evidence. One assigned physical UUID per seed across both tiers; maximise already resident Tier A score sets, then saved GPU time, then UUID. Rescore only constituents not already on that GPU. Deduplicate calls across families, seeds sharing a GPU, and tiers; Tier B timings are incremental after Tier A. Retain already admissible seed contrasts. General-v1 is charged once per checkpoint/GPU. Retain item-level outputs, token counts, identity, hash-bound receipts and frozen scorer/prompt/decoding. Assignments are planning choices, not availability claims; any replacement requires a prospective write-once assignment and compatible environment. No training.

teacher.if_not_qualified: DOES_NOT_QUALIFY; a hardest-types variant only as a separate declared decision on this screen panel; the 100-item evaluation set and the 500-item training pool stay untouched
